# T-1: Preserve mandatory blocking

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
mandatory authority を持つ finding が recurrence cap に達しても must-fix のまま gate-blocking となる policy を実装する。

## Acceptance Criteria
- mandatory finding at and above maxOccurrences returns MustFixDisposition with requiresRepair=true.
- Existing explicit allow/defer decisions remain the only non-evidence path for a mandatory finding to become non-blocking.

## Implementation Notes
FindingDispositionPolicy.classify() の mandatory branch を変更する。DeferredDisposition class と non-mandatory behavior は残す。

## Test Strategy
unit/spec-local tests cover repeatCount boundary and above-bound mandatory findings plus non-mandatory regression.
